name: check-loop-tightness
hypothesis: Models understand checks should run iteratively but misinterpret 'iterate' as occasional verification rather than a tight loop (change→check→change→check). Restructuring to make the loop pattern explicit—'change one thing → RUN check immediately → if fail, modify and check again'—forces checking after every single code change instead of batching changes between checks.
prediction: Output-mismatch failures decrease from 6 to 3-4; bugfix-statemachine improves from 0/3 (currently completely failing). Explicit loop structure prevents the common pattern of making multiple changes without re-validating.
